column1: # Heap allocation sites of the ZisK guest, as a budget model (HEAP_BUDGET.md).
# scripts/heap_bound.py reads this: `fixed`, `tx` and `arena` rows SUM per
# backend; `gas` rows take the MAX (one gas unit is spent once, so per-gas heap
# is bounded by the costliest way to spend it). `both` applies to evmone+zevm.
# Static .bss (keccak-f memo 100 MiB, zevm's 128 MiB EVM-memory zones and 33 MiB
# frames) is NOT here: it is outside _heap_start.._heap_end, so it does not count
# against the heap. Witness/code bytes are viewed in the input region, not
# copied; the heap rows that index TOUCHED state are the gas rows below. A
# witness larger than the 2 GiB input region is the S3 ceiling (operator-side),
# bytes_per_unit: absolute for `fixed`/`arena`, B per regular-gas for `gas`,
